title: コンピュータシステム基礎
subtitle: Foundations of Computer Systems
keywords: Binary Encoding 2.Logical and arithmetic operations 3.Logic Circuit 4.CPU 5.Machine Code
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn how to store information as “binary data” on computer systems. (2) Learn logic circuits to understand the behavior of computer systems. (3) Learn the basic mechanism of processing “machine code” inside computer systems.
advice: Learn the fundamentals of the configuration and behavior of program-stored computers for base systems of AI and IoT. Understand the function of instructions and concrete operation of computers through circuit design exercises. 1. Basic structure of a computer 2. data representation and codes 3. logic circuits 4. Main memory and address 5. CPU and instruction execution 6. Instruction Cycle 7. Machine language instructions and assembly language 8. Program Processing
books: 1:論理回路入門[工学社] 2:コンピュータ概論 情報システム入門 第8版[共立出版]

activityGoals.body: Be able to convert and compute base 2-decimal numbers, to explain the coding of information.
Be able to explain the role of each device in a computer.
Be able to explain basic instruction execution.
Be able to explain the operation of circuits composed of logic gate elements (AND, OR, NOT, etc.).
Be able to explain the operation of encoders, decoders, and multiplexers.
Be able to construct an n-bit addition circuit using fulladders.
